definitions: A group of long, unbranched polysaccharides containing repeating disaccharide units, found in the extracellular matrix and connective tissues.
Also known as mucopolysaccharides, they play crucial roles in cell signaling, tissue organization, and lubrication.
examples: Hyaluronic acid is a type of glycosaminoglycans.
The extracellular matrix is rich in glycosaminoglycans.
